deinit_prefetch_contract.r580: reenable only when RM faultBufferHandle exists, prefetch is disabled, and prefetch_fault_supported is true
deinit_prefetch_contract.r595: reenable when RM faultBufferHandle exists and prefetch is disabled
deinit_prefetch_contract.synthetic_case: the final vector sets the compatibility-shim capability false on both sources; this is a R580 counterfactual and not a live R595 field

limits: Exact fault_buffer_init_replayable_faults and fault_buffer_reinit_replayable_faults bodies are compiled and called for both pinned source trees.

Exact fault_buffer_deinit_replayable_faults body is called after all three allocation failure points, RM page-fault ownership failure, and prefetch cleanup states; frees are counted and returned pointers checked null.
Exact outer parent-GPU init, resume, and deinit functions are called for RM-init, replayable-init, non-replayable-init failure, plus successful resume/teardown cases.
RM Interface and non-replayable UVM calls are synthetic collaborators; their proprietary or separately sourced implementation bodies are not executed here.
The nonempty-tracker guard aborts at the source UVM_ASSERT before deinit proceeds.
HAL entry size, GET/PUT reads, prefetch callbacks, allocator, tracker, and RM ownership API are synthetic CPU collaborators; GET/PUT callback bodies are tested separately by the Volta ring harness.
Partial-allocation cleanup executes the NVIDIA deinit helper against CPU allocations, not the kernel allocator or live RM objects.
The R595 prefetch=false vector is a synthetic counterfactual because that release removed the prefetch_fault_supported field; it is not a supported live R595 GPU state.
No UVM module, RM, GPU, DMA, interrupt, CUDA context, or runtime fault is exercised.

failure_paths: RM init failure clears a partially populated faultBufferHandle and skips RM destroy
replayable allocation failure unwinds partial UVM state and releases RM page-fault ownership
non-replayable initialization failure unwinds replayable state and destroys RM fault info
success followed by resume refresh and deinit releases owned resources
outer_caller_contract.r580: asserts replayable support and conditionally initializes/deinitializes non-replayable fault buffers
outer_caller_contract.r595: omits replayable support assertions and calls non-replayable init/deinit unconditionally

prefetch_false_counterfactual.scope: synthetic field value; GV100 source initializes R580 capability true, and R595 has no such field

reinit_contract.prefetch: exact helper replays enable/disable according to fault_buffer.prefetch_faults_enabled
reinit_contract.readback: exact helper refreshes cached GET and PUT from the selected Volta HAL callbacks

supersedes.reason: v2 compiled but did not invoke the exact reinitialization helper; v3 exercises GET/PUT refresh and both prefetch callback states
